# Aron Bites

> Aron Bites (https://aronbites.com) is a premier Indian manufacturer and direct-to-consumer & B2B brand specializing in authentic Ratlami Sev, Indori Sev, Nylon Sev, and heritage Malwa namkeen snacks.

## Overview
- **Brand Name**: Aron Bites
- **Official Website**: https://aronbites.com
- **Origin & Heritage**: Handcrafted in the snack capital of India — Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
- **Core Offerings**: Freshly prepared Sev, spiced namkeen, retail doorstep packs (200g, 500g, 1kg), wholesale & bulk supply (10kg to quintals), and free B2B business samples.
- **Quality Commitment**: 100% pure stone-ground besan (gram flour), cold-pressed oils, authentic aromatic spices (cloves, hing, black pepper), zero artificial preservatives, zero compromise on crunch and freshness.

- [Bulk & Wholesale Orders](https://aronbites.com/bulk-orders): B2B pricing tiers, wholesale supply for caterers, retailers, restaurants, and distributors.

## Signature Product Categories
1. **Indori Sev**: Light, airy, delicate, perfectly seasoned with classic hing and carom seeds. Ideal for Indori poha, chaat, and daily snacking.
2. **Ratlami Sev**: Bold, spicy, infused with real ground cloves (laung), black pepper, and authentic Malwi heat. Renowned for its rich aroma and crunch.
3. **Thin Nylon Sev**: Super fine, crispy golden strands designed specifically for sev puri, bhel puri, and garnishing street food delicacies.
4. **Garlic Sev & Special Blends**: Robust garlic-infused namkeen with balanced spices for savory snack lovers.

## Ordering & Fulfillment
- **Retail Minimum**: ₹199 minimum cart value.
- **Free Delivery**: Free shipping available on orders above ₹499.
- **Packaging**: Multi-layer moisture-lock food-grade nitrogen-flushed pouches ensuring 3 to 6 months shelf life.
- **Pan-India Delivery**: Dispatched within 24–48 hours to all pincodes across India.
- **Payments**: 100% secure checkout via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, Wallets).
